(A_project_whose_record_holds_two_repos_pauses_a_task_with_an_empty_field_naming_the_field, A_filled_field_is_kept_and_a_later_step_acts_on_the_repo_it_names, and and says why they can arrive before those assertions.\u0022,\u0022On the commit the branch starts from, a test fails every time when the software module\\u0027s handling of the flow-run stop is made to finish before runner.Commands is read. The ordering is forced by waiting on a definite signal, not by a sleep. The same test passes after the fix, and the pull request says how the ordering was forced and gives both results.\u0022,\u0022The RepoFieldTests class passes at least 20 consecutive runs by class filter, and the pull request gives the command and its result.\u0022,\u0022No test is skipped, retried, given a longer wait, or moved out of parallel execution, and no assertion is weakened or removed. Each of the two paused tests still asserts with Assert.Empty that the step ran no command (asserting on a snapshot of the commands taken when the step answers is allowed), and A_filled_field_is_kept_and_a_later_step_acts_on_the_repo_it_names still asserts that every command its step ran is against clone two and that the list is not empty.\u0022,\u0022The change touches no file under src/.\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022Seen once in 30 full-suite runs (run 25 of the set behind pull request #76\\u0027s description, logged at /tmp/repro-66cb/after2/suite-25.txt while that file lasts), beside an unrelated SQLite Error 5 failure: two git commands with working directory projects/multi/repos reached runner.Commands before Assert.Empty at RepoFieldTests.cs:108. The likely cause is the stop at RepoFieldTests.cs:211. The module feed delivers that stop to SoftwareModule.FeedAsync in the background (ModuleFeed.cs:57 polls every 50 ms, :130), and ProjectClones.RemoveAsync then lists the worktrees of every clone of the project (ProjectClones.cs:588 and :835), from the clones\\u0027 parent directory (Git.cs:38). RepoFieldTests.cs:130-131 already documents that each stop\\u0027s delivery lists the clones. Setup cannot be the cause: RepoClones awaits each command in sequence and ScriptedCommandRunner records synchronously. Work from origin/main. Non-goals: no change under src/ (task d6251767 changes how stops reach modules; keep clear of ModuleFeed and SoftwareModule); the SQLite flakes (task 088127cc covers them); no CI configuration
